title: Age as an NFL draft taboo? Teams embrace the 'seasoned rookie' in paradigm shift

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Age as an NFL draft taboo? Teams embrace the 'seasoned rookie' in paradigm shift
sources.description: In previous years, being an older NFL draft prospect might sink a player's stock. Now, however, 24- and 25-year-old rookies are being embraced.
